title: Jeremy Cohn Krillion Day 1
description: Seven categories, curated by yours truly.

questions.prompt: Name a car brand that actively sells cars today.
Name an animal species currently housed at the Saint Louis Zoo.
Name a metro area in the 50 United States with a population over 500,000.
Name an MLB player who was born outside the 50 United States and played in the 2026 MLB season.
Name a burger restaurant chain currently operating 50+ locations in the United States.
Name an item you'd find in a bathroom.
Name a California-based four-year college or university with at least 2,500 undergraduate students.
